    Representation-finiteness of algebra quotients #

    Restriction along a quotient map realizes quotient modules as the full exact subcategory annihilated by the quotient ideal. In particular, representation-finiteness descends to every two-sided quotient. We also record the small algebra-equivalence transport needed to return from left modules over the quotient of an opposite algebra to right modules.

    The proofs are adapted from CartanDeterminant.Algebra.RepresentationFinite and CartanDeterminant.Algebra.RepresentationFiniteIdeals at homological-conjectures commit 916afb44; the unrelated ideal-lattice and representation-infinite applications are omitted.
